C4_tau_is_robust_anchor.statement: at the model angle the tau anchor (the delta-stable wall) predicts m_mu to ~5.5% (tracking the 2.7% lambda6 error); the electron prediction is intrinsically uncertain (node). tau is the robust anchor. The user-requested electron anchor is exact only when delta is taken from data (C2).

C6_full_fermion_kg_table.statement: with m_e + the locked cell, every fermion reads out in kg. Leptons are PREDICTED by the shape to ~0.1%; quark entries are the measured masses converted to kg (the model fits, not predicts, the quark texture).
